title: [시설팀] 각 호관 지하저수조 및 옥상 고가수조 청소로 인한 단수 안내 (2026학년도 하반기)

summary: 수도법 시행령 제24조에 따른 저수조 청소로 인해 교내 건물 단수 및 수압강하가 진행됩니다.
1차(10/30 18:00 ~ 11/1 08:00): 인하드림1~3관, 서호관, 나빌레관, 학군단, 정석학술정보관, 반도체교육동 수압강하
물탱크 청소 및 물 보충 상황에 따라 단수 시간이 일부 변동될 수 있습니다.
analysis.easyExplanation: 교내 물탱크 청소 작업으로 인해 지정된 건물에서 주말 동안 수압이 낮아지거나 물이 나오지 않습니다. 특히 11월 13일 저녁부터 15일 아침까지 본관, 5호관 전체, 2호 북관은 단수되므로 이용 시 주의해야 합니다.

en.title: [Facilities Team] Notice of Water Outage and Pressure Drop Due to Water Tank Cleaning (Second Half of 2026)
summary: Water outages and water pressure drops will occur across campus buildings due to mandatory water tank cleaning under the Water Supply Act.
Phase 1 (Oct 30 18:00 – Nov 1 08:00): Water pressure drop in Inha Dream 1–3, Seoho Hall, Nabille Hall, ROTC, Jungseok Memorial Library, and Semiconductor Education Bldg.
Phase 2 (Oct 31 18:00 – Nov 2 08:00): Water pressure drop in Hi-Tech Center, Bldg 6, Bldg 7, Bldg 9, Law School Bldg, and Lifelong Education Center.
Phase 3 (Nov 13 18:00 – Nov 15 08:00): Complete water outage in Main Bldg, Bldg 5 (North/East/West/South), and Bldg 2 North.
Phase 4 (Nov 14 18:00 – Nov 16 08:00): Water pressure drop in 60th Anniversary Memorial Hall, Bldg 2 (East/South), and Bldg 4.
Water outage and pressure drop times may slightly vary depending on tank cleaning and refilling progress.
en.easyExplanation: Water pressure will drop or water service will be temporarily shut off in designated campus buildings during weekends for routine water tank cleaning. In particular, the Main Building, Building 5, and Building 2 North will experience a full water shutoff from the evening of November 13 to the morning of November 15.
en.target: Users of the affected campus buildings
